text:
vikram: Heads-up — eu-west-1 zephyr-8b-ptq queue depth spiking, hot-shard backlog ~420 reqs, tail latency climbing. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/dev/queues?region=eu-west-1 :rotating_light:

anya: :eyes: seeing it too, p95 doubled in the last 10m. any deploys or config changes?

vikram: no deploys. looks traffic-driven — partner onboarding campaign + average token length x2. KV miss rate for zephyr-8b up to 87%.

lee: can we reroute new sessions to a smaller variant (zephyr-4b-ptq) as a fallback? admission controller currently uses fairshare weights per model. suggest temporary weight shift + rate cap for 8b.

vikram: proposed plan:
1) set soft rate cap for zephyr-8b in eu-west-1 to 50 rps
2) route new sessions to zephyr-4b-ptq by updating routing rule for model_family=zephyr
3) spin up 4 reclaimed preemptible nodes to absorb backlog
4) enable prefix caching for zephyr-8b for 30m to reduce KV churn

anya: +1 to plan. also add an alert if queue doesn't drop 30% in 20m.

ben (infra): reclaiming 4 preemptible nodes now. changing admission controller throttle for low-priority to 65%. running commands:
```bash
./adminctl nodes reclaim --region eu-west-1 --count 4
./adminctl admission set --region eu-west-1 --model zephyr-8b --rate 50
./adminctl route update --region eu-west-1 --model_family zephyr --target zephyr-4b-ptq --mode canary --pct 40
```

ops-bot: Runbook entry created: INCIDENT-2026-238 — eu-west-1 zephyr-8b backlog. Assigned: natalie (oncall).

natalie (oncall): on it. starting canary redirect to zephyr-4b-ptq at 40% now, will monitor queue/p95.

vikram: quick metrics snapshot before changes:
```
model              | queue | p95 (ms)
zephyr-8b-ptq      | 420   | 820
zephyr-4b-ptq      | 30    | 220
kv_miss_rate(8b)   | 87%   | -
```

lee: if canary shows lower overall cost and latency we can widen route to 80% and keep 8b for high-priority only. note: longer-term we should tune kernel selection for longer sequences; current kernel choice seems to degrade at >1k tokens.

natalie (oncall): 15m check — queue down 28% so far, p95 reduced to 640 for 8b, zephyr-4b can handle extra load. keeping canary at 40% for another 10m.

vikram: good progress. if we don't hit >=30% reduction in the next 10m we'll flip to 80% fallback and schedule a deeper perf postmortem. I'll update incident and notif partners. :thumbsup:
